stories.title: Figma agent is now available in FigJam and Slides
stories.summary: Figma announced that the Figma agent is now available in FigJam and Slides, helping teams explore ideas, prepare for meetings, and present designs.
key_facts: Figma agent is now available in FigJam and Slides.
Helps users explore ideas, prepare for meetings, and present designs.
Aimed at moving collaborative work forward.
stories.design_implication: When a team gathers in a shared whiteboard to untangle a messy user journey, synthesizing dozens of stickies into coherent themes usually consumes half the meeting. With an integrated design agent embedded directly into FigJam and Slides, brainstorming transitions instantly into structured presentation decks without manual sorting. Start by designating specific canvas zones for agent input during workshops, turning raw discussion artifacts into review-ready formats before the session ends.

evidence.claim: Helps explore ideas, prepare meetings, and present designs
evidence.quote: Whether you’re exploring an idea, preparing for a meeting, or presenting your designs, the Figma agent can help you move work forward.

stories.title: Agents can now manage AI Gateway through Vercel MCP
stories.summary: Vercel announced that agents can now manage AI Gateway through Vercel MCP, allowing users to create virtual models and change settings using plain language.
key_facts: Agents can now manage AI Gateway through Vercel MCP.
Users can ask agents in plain language to create virtual models.
Allows changing model settings without updating client code or redeploying.
stories.design_implication: In a prototyping session where frontend designers test multiple language models for an interface, tweaking API configurations typically requires diving into environment files and redeploying code. Managing gateway infrastructure directly through natural language agent prompts removes technical friction from rapid experimentation. Start by configuring a shared MCP connection for your design engineering squad, enabling designers to swap underlying model endpoints directly from their chat environment during live prototyping.
